approval_evidence.quote: 11/18/2004 ORIG-1 Approval (Drugs@FDA, Original Approvals or Tentative Approvals)

series_start_reason: First quarter printed: Q4 2009 is the first column of table 7 (Top 20 Pharmaceuticals Division quarterly product sales, five quarters Q4 2009 to Q4 2010) of the Roche Investor Update of 2 February 2011 (inv-update-2011-02-02-e.pdf). No earlier Roche quarterly CHF figure was found: Q1-Q3 2009 are printed only as local-currency growth rates (Q1 2010 vs. Q1 2009 and so on) in that update, the Half-Year Report 2010 prints six-month 2010 totals only, and Roche's 2009 and 2010 results releases could not be retrieved.
series_end_reason: Roche's FY2018 release (f_190131_ir_full_year_results_2018_en.pdf) is the last to print Tarceva (Q4 2018 113); the Q1 2019 release's Top 20 table ends at Xeloda 108 with no Tarceva row, and no later results release read mentions the brand. Not checked: Roche Finance Reports / Annual Reports.
notes: Printed line is 'Tarceva'; worldwide Total column of Roche's reported product sales (the United States, Europe, Japan and International tables are separate). Roche is the only issuer used: it prints the line itself, so the rule-12 fallbacks (partners, prior owners) were not needed. 2010Q1 to 2010Q4 and several later quarters are read from later releases' earlier columns because the own release carries a year-to-date table only. launch_quarter left null: FDA approval was 18 Nov 2004 and no Roche document read states a launch quarter.
search_log: reused the earlier Roche crawl (roche.com/investors/events/{q1,hy,q3,annual-results}-YYYY, 2016-2026) and its downloaded Investor update PDFs, plus the assets.cwp.roche.com/imported/en/med-cor-YYYY-MM-DD-e.pdf results releases for 2011-2015 found by dated probing; 63 results releases from the FY2010 release (2011-02-02) to the half-year 2026 release (2026-07-23) were read as text

per release read two tables: the worldwide 'Top 20 Pharmaceuticals Division quarterly product sales' table (five quarter columns, Total table that precedes the United States/Europe/Japan/International tables) and the year-to-date product sales table (Total, United States, Europe, Japan, International); quarters taken from the own release quarter column when printed, else the Q1 year-to-date table (three months), else the earliest later release that prints the quarter, else year-to-date differences

wherever both a printed quarter and a year-to-date difference existed they were compared: no difference found; for every calendar year whose four quarters are in the series the sum equals the full-year (January-December) figure of that year's FY release
Roche half-year/annual reports and Finance Reports, and the 2009-2010 quarterly results releases, were not retrieved or used for rows; Chugai/Genentech documents were not used

end of series: Q1 2019 release (f_190417_ir_q1_2019_en.pdf) Top 20 table runs from Avastin 1,798 to Xeloda 108 with no Tarceva row; no results release from Q1 2019 to half-year 2026 (30 read) contains the string 'Tarceva'. Not checked: Roche Finance Reports / Annual Reports for 2019 onward, which might still print the brand

found the Roche Investor Update of 2 February 2011 (https://assets.cwp.roche.com/imported/en/inv-update-2011-02-02-e.pdf, FY2010 results) via search: its table 7 prints a five-quarter worldwide Top 20 table Q4 2009 to Q4 2010; the 2009Q4 value is taken from column 1 and the 2010 columns equal the rows already in the series

probed assets.cwp.roche.com/imported/en/{inv-update,med-cor}-YYYY-MM-DD-e.pdf for every weekday in 15 Jan-15 Feb, 10-30 Apr, 10-31 Jul and 10-31 Oct of 2009 and 2010 (HEAD): none answered, so no Roche results release or investor update dated 2009 or 2010 was retrievable; web.archive.org CDX listing is blocked by the egress policy

Q1-Q3 2009: the FY2010 investor update prints only growth rates against those quarters (Q1 2010 vs. Q1 2009 etc.) and the Half-Year Report 2010 prints 2010 six-month sales only, so no CHF figure for those quarters is printed in any retrieved document; none was derived or estimated
